newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,713 contract.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,713 contract.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,713 contracts compared with 877 overnight Thursday.
There were 202 wheat, 939 corn, 485 soybean, 62 soymeal, three soyoil, one wheat call, one corn call, 19 soybean calls and one soybean put traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/4 to 1-1/2 cents lower, corn was 1-3/4 to 2-1/4 cents lower and soybeans were two to 10 cents lower.
